title: Model-job lane: job endpoints and cancel-on-lapse against the Meta Model API
done_when: make suite BACKEND=http passes T12 against a local server, using a fake Model API in tests
constraints: Read AGENTS.md first; the spec wins over the code
Never edit conformance-draft/ tests or SPEC.md in this task, and never weaken a test
Writes are POST only; a GET on a write path answers 405 and changes nothing
No key, token or credential in any response, page, log or commit
Run make check before committing; one task per branch; do not push
Tests never call the real Model API
The Model API key lives only in the host's secret store
notes: Cancel a running job with POST /v1/responses/{id}/cancel when its lease lapses (status cancel_requested).
